description: This PHP script defines a class delete_project_tasks used to delete tasks associated with a project when the project is deleted. It includes database interaction to mark related project tasks as deleted.

classes.name: delete_project_tasks
classes.description: Class responsible for deleting tasks related to a specific project after the project has been deleted.

methods.name: delete_tasks
methods.description: Deletes (marks as deleted) all tasks associated with a given project bean by setting their 'deleted' flag to '1'.
